name: SAM PRODUCTS PVT LTD
india_angle: SAM PRODUCTS PVT LTD is a 'MAKE IN INDIA' initiative, manufacturing clean room and allied products domestically.
summary: SAM PRODUCTS PVT LTD specializes in manufacturing clean room equipment such as air showers and air curtains, which are essential for maintaining contamination-free environments in semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their products support the infrastructure needs of semiconductor fabs and packaging facilities.
